document.title: Show a failure screen when a Deck App throws after boot
document.summary: Every uncaught Deck App error (render, effects, input handlers, timers, microtasks, module eval) now records a failure on `VdJsRuntime`, stops the JS loop, and paints the Deck App Failure Screen with the message, a stack excerpt, and the Start hint.
document.why: Errors after boot are only logged, React unmounts the root, and [the user sees nothing](source:s1).

sources.title: [Claude] Deck App errors after boot leave a blank screen
sources.gist: Add a runtime-owned error boundary and route uncaught JS errors to a native error screen with message, stack excerpt, and Start hint.

lookFor: Unhandled promise rejections still only fail silently: QuickJS turns a throw inside a `.then` callback into a rejected promise, so `JS_ExecutePendingJob` does not return an error and `drain_microtasks` never reports it. Catching those needs `JS_SetHostPromiseRejectionTracker`, which this change does not add.

groups.title: Failure state on VdJsRuntime
groups.why: The JS thread, the error boundary, and the font loader need one place to record a Deck App failure that the main thread can paint.
groups.summary: `js_runtime_fail` stores the first message and stack on `VdJsRuntime`, the JS loop exits once `failed` is set, and `clear_failure` runs on init, start, and stop.
lookFor: Subtle: the JS loop now stops on the first failure, so after a timer throws no more timers, input, or fetch callbacks run; the thread exits and frees the context while `runtime->thread` stays set until `js_runtime_stop` joins it.

Race: the JS thread writes `failure_message` before setting the `volatile bool failed`, with no memory barrier; this matches the existing `ready` flag protocol and the strings are never written again once `failed` is true.
`js_runtime_fail` is `static inline` in the header so `timer_reload_harness`, which links only `timeout.c` and `error.c`, does not pull in the runtime thread.

groups.title: Native exception reporters
groups.why: Handlers, timers, effects, and microtasks were [only `TraceLog`ged](source:s1).
groups.summary: `js_report_exception` in the new `error.c` replaces the log-only blocks in input dispatch, `run_timeouts`, `drain_microtasks`, `runtime.js` eval, and `updateContainer`, and finds the runtime through `JS_GetContextOpaque`.
lookFor: `timeout.c` changes only the exception branch, so it rebases cleanly onto PR #61's `run_timeouts` rewrite; the old per-tick id log line is gone.
A context with no opaque runtime (the timer harness) only logs, so `js_report_exception` is safe outside `js_thread_func`.

groups.title: Runtime error boundary
groups.why: `main.tsx` had [no error boundary](source:s1), so a render or effect error after boot unmounted the root.
groups.summary: `DeckAppErrorBoundary` wraps `ThemeProvider` and the Deck App, renders `null` after an error, and reports it through the new `nativeReportDeckAppError` global.
lookFor: The reconciler callback is renamed to `onRecoverableError` because React passes it only errors it already recovered from; behavior is unchanged, it still logs.
The boundary sends `error.stack` and falls back to `info.componentStack` only when the error has no stack.

groups.title: Deck App Failure Screen paint
groups.why: The issue asks that [the failure paint matters as much as the success paint](source:s1).
groups.summary: `bootstrap_draw_deck_canvas` replaces the old "failed to start" text with `draw_deck_app_failure_screen`, and `main.c` drops its separate recovery hint and stops polling Deck App input while failed.
lookFor: `draw_failure_lines` wraps by summing per-glyph `MeasureText` widths each frame; it caps the message at 4 lines and the stack at 12.
Font and image load failures now carry their error text onto the screen through `js_runtime_fail`; a boot-time font failure is still cleared by `js_runtime_start`, as before.

commits.subject: fix(runtime): show a failure screen when a Deck App throws after boot
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Uncaught errors from render, effects, input handlers, timers, and microtasks were only logged, so React unmounted the root and the screen went blank.

A runtime-owned error boundary reports render errors through nativeReportDeckAppError, and every native exception site now goes through js_report_exception. Both record the first failure on VdJsRuntime, stop the JS loop, and bootstrap paints the Deck App Failure Screen (message, stack excerpt, Start hint) in place of the old "failed to start" text. Stopping or restarting the runtime clears the failure.
